summary: The packet preserves the major hooks, terminology, and active continuity without accidental spoilers or substantive contradiction. Actionable issues are a recurring direct-speech formatting drift in Chapters 421, 423, and 424, one category-capitalization drift, several awkward English constructions, and an unclear continuity-summary description of White Flame’s return.
